description.p: Camlet is a lightweight native camera overlay for presentations, recordings, and calls. It provides a transparent always-on-top window, configurable shapes and rings, camera controls, and a compact cascading settings menu.
Refines menu sizing and stacking, refreshes native branding, aligns Linux launcher metadata, and reduces release size.
Fixes desktop icon association and alignment, makes menus more compact, and reliably reapplies the always-on-top window level.
Improves camera startup, native resizing, cascading menu behavior, submenu aiming, panel layouts, and Rust-native branding.
